A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SAFE, the same framework for automated Rust proof generation. All 28 pages, including Appendices A–F, are readable; text, equations, tables, figures, and code listings support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original proof-generation experiments on VerusBench and CodeNet-Test, ablations, synthesized-data statistics, and additional experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Table 1 and the smaller-backbone experiment in Appendix E.4 and Table 8.

M1.justification: SAFE’s code translation, specification synthesis and filtering, proof synthesis, and self-debugging procedures are unchanged. Algorithm 1 and the training objectives remain the same.

E1.justification: Both versions use MBPP and CodeNet for data synthesis and evaluate on VerusBench and CodeNet-Test with the same task coverage. The new training-data link does not introduce another dataset or test scenario.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains GPT-4o Raw/Prompt, raw LLaMa3.1-8B, and raw DeepSeekCoder-33B comparisons. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the round-wise, specification-quality, and smaller-backbone experiments.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, benchmark sizes, Accuracy@K metrics, decoding procedures, model sizes, and training settings are unchanged. The DeepSeekCoder-1.3B experiment and its protocol already appear in v2.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same analyses of self-evolution rounds, decoding and debugging strategies, and specification quality. Appendix E’s supplementary analyses and Appendix F’s successful and unsuccessful proof examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix E.3 retains the same paired t-tests, significance threshold, and p-value reporting in Tables 5–7. No seed, repeated-run, confidence-interval, or other uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings throughout the main text and appendices are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains VerusBench Accuracy@2 of 52.52% for LLaMa3.1 SAFE+ and 14.39% for raw GPT-4o; no result entries are added or corrected.

T1.justification: The specification correctness/completeness definitions, Equations (1)–(3), and formal proof examples remain unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proof reasoning are added or revised.

C1.justification: The claims about overcoming proof-data scarcity through self-evolution and improving proof generation through self-debugging are retained. The added abstract sentence provides data-access information without changing the scientific contributions or performance claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the experimental results are unchanged. Appendices D and F retain the same limitations concerning large-project dependencies, repeated debugging, and missing proof constructs in training data.

D1.justification: v3 adds an abstract statement that the training dataset is available on Hugging Face and a footnote identifying microsoft/Verus_Training_Data; v2 lacks this access reference. The prompts, implementation details, and hyperparameters in Appendices B–C are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, bibliography, and positioning relative to earlier proof-generation and self-evolution research are unchanged. The dataset-access footnote does not introduce a new cited research work.

P1.justification: The abstract gains one data-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date text changes. Existing prose, terminology, section organization, and appendix structure are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: The new URL footnote changes the first-page layout and shifts introduction text across pages 1–3; the existing footnote on page 6 is renumbered. Figures, tables, algorithms, and code listings retain their content and presentation.

improvement.justification: The new abstract statement and dataset footnote provide a concrete training-data location absent from v2, modestly improving reproducibility documentation. The scientific evidence and substantive presentation remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access information, but do not independently establish the linked resource’s accessibility or contents.
